audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Skill/Singed/Singed/Skill/Skill/Singed/Singed. Level 2 and 3 were awarded to Singed on the strength of a combo that does not exist at level 2, and levels 4-6 were called even in a lane Singed wins 59.1% of the time.
audit.why: Mirror alignment: audits/top/zac__singed.json audits the same lane from Zac's side and lands on Skill / Skill / Skill / Singed / Singed / Singed / Singed, with the grounding as the stated reason for the level 4-5 flip. The two directions must not disagree, and Zac's side is the one that already reasoned it through.
audit.corrected: Skill / Skill / Skill / Singed / Singed / Singed / Singed. Note this deliberately overrides the packet chart, which gives Singed levels 2 and 3.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] is labelled 'Lvl 2' and reads 'Fling + Mega Adhesive comes online'; whys[1] repeats it as 'Mega Adhesive root plus Fling is online' at level 2. At level 2 Singed has Poison Trail plus exactly one of Mega Adhesive or Fling. The root combo is a level 3 spike, not a level 2 one.
audit.why: This is a whole level of false confidence. A player told to root-and-fling at 2 will step up into Zac with half the combo and lose the trade to blob sustain.
audit.corrected: Singed spikes: level 3 (goo + Fling together — grounding and the root), level 6 (Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds), Rylai's. Zac spikes: Elastic Slingshot at 21/18/15/12/9s, Let's Bounce at 120/105/90s, and Cell Division's revive on a 5-minute cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The two facts that actually explain a 59.1% win rate were both absent, and two ability claims were wrong. (1) Mega Adhesive GROUNDS, and Elastic Slingshot is Zac's only dash, only engage and only escape — the word grounding appears nowhere. (2) Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, which halves the Cell Division blob healing that is Zac's entire sustain model; the page instead credits level 6 to 'Zac's limited damage output'. (3) wants.foe[0] writes 'a CC chain with Cell Division knockup' — Cell Division is the blob/revive passive and has no knockup; the knockup is on Elastic Slingshot itself and on Let's Bounce. (4) wants.you[2] says run at him 'for 14 seconds while it is on cooldown' — Elastic Slingshot is 21/18/15/12/9s. 14s is Stretching Strikes.
audit.why: Grounding is the whole matchup: goo on the floor means his engage will not fire at all, which is a stronger statement than any amount of kiting advice. The Grievous Wounds line is what the level 6 spike actually is. And a wrong cooldown number sends a player back into range seven seconds early.
audit.corrected: Mega Adhesive (17/16/15/14/13s, 1000 range) slows and grounds — while Zac stands in it Elastic Slingshot will not fire. Fling him into your own goo and he is rooted on top of it. Insanity Potion (100s) puts Grievous Wounds on Poison Trail, halving blob healing. Elastic Slingshot is 21/18/15/12/9s. Unstable Matter is a flat 5s and deals a percentage of YOUR max health as magic damage, so health stacking feeds it. Cell Division splits him into 4 bloblets on fatal damage and revives him — 5-minute cooldown — so poison the bloblets rather than walking away from a 'kill'.

audit.whatIsWrong: full.diff reads EVEN and diffRating 6/10 for a 59.1% matchup over 692 games — the highest win rate in this slice.
audit.why: The mirror audit raised the same class of problem from Zac's side and could not fix it there. Calling Singed's best lane 'even' misprices every decision on the page.
audit.corrected: diff FAVOURED, diffRating 4/10, and Zac's carry threat down from 7/10 to 5/10 to match the page's own 'low carry ceiling' line.

edits.after: Insanity Potion puts Grievous Wounds on Poison Trail, halving the blob healing Cell Division runs on — that is the real level 6 spike.

edits.before: Elastic Slingshot is his only real threat window; if he lands it and chains W+Q CC he can actually punish your run pattern, so always track his E cooldown before committing.
edits.after: Elastic Slingshot is his only engage and his only escape, 21 seconds at rank 1 falling to 9 — and it is the one ability your Mega Adhesive switches off completely.

edits.after: Land Elastic Slingshot from brush before your goo is down, then chain its knockup into Unstable Matter's percent-health damage

edits.after: Force him to burn Elastic Slingshot on a bad angle, then run at him freely for its 21 seconds at rank 1

edits.after: At level 2 you have Poison Trail plus one of goo or Fling, never both — Zac's blob sustain still holds, so keep walking past him rather than stopping to trade.

edits.before: Full kit running: root him, Fling backward, trail behind — he cannot disengage cleanly and his passive sustain cannot outpace repeated cloud exposure.
edits.after: Level 3 is the real combo: the goo grounds Elastic Slingshot, a Fling into that goo roots him, and the cloud does the rest while he cannot slingshot away.

edits.before: Elastic Slingshot cooldown is your farming calendar — proxy behind his tower the instant it lands on cooldown and he cannot follow you through the wave.
edits.after: Elastic Slingshot's 21 seconds at rank 1 is your farming calendar — proxy behind his tower the instant it lands and he has no way at all to follow you.

edits.before: Insanity Potion regen outpaces all the damage Zac's Q and Unstable Matter can produce; run at him freely and ghost-proxy his tower all game.
edits.after: Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds halves his blob healing — that, not your regen, is what wins level 6. Unstable Matter still scales off your own HP.

edits.before: At level 1 Zac actually wins most short trades — his passive (Cell Division blobs) gives him surprising sustain, and you have no root yet. Do not stand and brawl; drop Poison Trail, walk past him, and let the cloud do the work while you keep moving. The moment level 2 hits, the dynamic flips: root him with Mega Adhesive, then Fling him backward so he lands inside the cloud he was trying to leave. He has zero escape before Elastic Slingshot comes up, and his blob sustain cannot keep pace with repeated poison exposure if you keep mobile.
edits.after: At level 1 Zac wins most short trades — Cell Division sheds a blob every time an ability hits you and he reabsorbs it, so he out-sustains a lone Poison Trail. Do not stand and brawl; drop the trail, walk past him, and let the cloud work while you keep moving. Level 2 is still his, because you only have one of goo or Fling. Level 3 is when it flips: Mega Adhesive grounds Elastic Slingshot so it will not fire, and a Fling into that same goo roots him inside the cloud he was trying to leave.

edits.before: Your proxy pattern is close to free against Zac. He has no AOE wave-clear speed to match you, and his Elastic Slingshot is his only gap-closer — the moment you see it go on cooldown, sprint behind his tower and cook the next wave in his face. At level 6 your Insanity Potion makes the 1v1 unwinnable for him: his damage output is low for a tank and your regen under ult eats everything his Q and W can throw at you. Use Ghost + ult to proxy aggressively; he will literally chase and fail every time.
edits.after: Your proxy pattern is close to free against Zac. Elastic Slingshot is his only gap-closer and it is 21 seconds at rank 1 — the moment it goes down, sprint behind his tower and cook the next wave in his face. At level 6 Insanity Potion makes the 1v1 unwinnable for him, and the reason is anti-heal: your Poison Trail applies Grievous Wounds for the full 100 seconds, so every blob he reabsorbs is worth half. Do keep respecting Unstable Matter — it is a flat 5s and takes a cut of your max health, so more HP means more damage taken.

edits.before: Zac's one real late-game role is engage for his team — his Elastic Slingshot and knock-up chain are dangerous in teamfights where you cannot Fling him away from allies. Never fight around his team; instead, force a split and make him choose between defending his tower and helping his team. With Rylai's and a second AP item your poison cloud is a permanent soft-CC zone he cannot walk through without dying slowly, and his blob passive cannot regenerate fast enough in sustained side-lane attrition. He is an off-meta top pick with low carry ceiling — you win the 1v1, win the side lane, and win the macro race.
edits.after: Zac's one real late-game role is engage — Elastic Slingshot and the Let's Bounce knock-up chain are dangerous in teamfights where you cannot Fling him off your carries. Never fight around his team; force a split and make him choose between his tower and his team. With Rylai's and a second AP item the cloud is a permanent slow zone he cannot cross safely, and Grievous Wounds keeps the blobs from saving him. Do not walk away from a kill: Cell Division splits him into four bloblets that recombine and revive him on a 5-minute cooldown, so run the trail over them and finish it.

edits.after: Goo grounds his E — proxy + kite, anti-heal his blobs. Singed wins the Elastic Slingshot windows.

notes: MIRROR REUSED: audits/top/zac__singed.json already established the grounding and the Grievous Wounds-vs-blob-healing findings; I restated both from Singed's side and matched its level chart exactly rather than the packet chart, which disagrees at levels 2 and 3. Following the mirror's lead I also did NOT claim Insanity Potion grants tenacity — Riot's text says only 'increased combat stats' and needsResearch.tenacityAffected is null. Both suspectNames are false positives. New on this side and not in the mirror: Cell Division's 5-minute revive was missing entirely, so the page told you to win the 1v1 without telling you he gets back up; and wants.foe[0] attributed a knockup to Cell Division, which has none.
